description:
Use this when the user wants the numbers for their posts: "how are my clips doing", "which TikTok took off",
        "how many views did my Short get", "show my scheduled posts". Returns per post the platform, status, post URL,
        caption, clip title, the latest views, likes, comments, shares and saves the platform sent (null = the platform
        sends no such count) and views at 1 hour, 24 hours and 7 days. platform: tiktok, youtube, instagram, ... or all
        (default). status filters draft, scheduled, posted or failed (empty = all; status "draft" lists the post_id that
        update_draft and delete_draft take). limit 1-50, newest first. Covers posts RipClip published or planned.
        Not for: a recap of the week (weekly_report), platform against platform (compare_platforms), what is growing
        fast (whats_taking_off) or follower counts (get_account_stats). Free and read only.
name: get_post_stats
title: Get post stats
